description: Small operation smoke matrix for Windows prebuilt package CI. These operations are intentionally conservative: they should execute through the public standalone API, preserve expected prims, export a temporary output layer, and reopen that output layer successfully.

operations.name: print_stats
operations.description: Read-only stats collection. Verifies hidden diagnostic operations execute through the packaged runtime.

operations.name: compute_extents
operations.description: Authors mesh extents where applicable. Safe on non-mesh assets and useful after geometry-changing operations.

operations.name: optimize_primvars_index_simplify
operations.description: Indexes duplicate primvar values and simplifies uniform primvars without removing material-bound data.
